name: Maya Reed

immutable.hair: chin-length, full, curly copper-auburn brown curls
immutable.watch: white dial, brown leather strap, LEFT wrist
immutable.jewelry: small gold hoops, thin triple gold necklace, plain gold ring

variable: white hard hat in the factory hall (no text)
generator_errors: smiling in comedy (dry is in the face, E3)
long, straight or plain dark-brown hair without the copper
face mixed with Claire or June in a shared chat

looks.L1: brown tweed blazer and trousers, black blouse, gold-buckle belt, brown ankle boots; white-dial watch with brown leather strap on the left wrist; hoops, gold necklace (EP03, V77)
looks.L3: cream shirt and trousers, caramel belt, brown ankle boots (EP02, V54)

camera: subtle handheld, wider frames to catch the body in the reaction (E14)
interpretation_rule: Maya speaks with timing and goes silent with her body. In comedy her face stays serious and the joke is in the timing. When it is serious, she stops moving and the joke dies before it reaches her mouth. Her care for Claire is always practical: food, sleep, time.

tears.1: max in S1, only for her friend

forbidden: fast speech in a serious scene
neutral face in a line about Claire
generation_suffix: Chin-length full curly copper-auburn hair. Green eyes, freckles. No smile unless the panel asks for one; never an open laugh. If the left wrist shows, a white-dial watch with a brown leather strap. Same face in every panel; never Claire's or June's face.

expressions.name: A gerente (o cronograma)
expressions.direction: Checking a schedule on a tablet, eyebrows level, completely unimpressed; everything is under her control.

expressions.name: Cobrando Claire de igual para igual
expressions.direction: Looking straight at Claire with calm authority, one eyebrow barely up: she is not intimidated at all.

expressions.name: Atenta (lendo a sala)
expressions.direction: Quietly watching the room, eyes moving, reading everyone; face still.

expressions.name: Pensativa
expressions.direction: A finger at her lips, eyes on the middle distance, weighing something.

expressions.name: Deadpan (a piada no timing)
expressions.direction: Perfectly serious face delivering a joke; not a trace of a smile; the comedy is in her stillness.

expressions.name: Ironia carinhosa
expressions.direction: A dry, fond look, one corner of the mouth barely moving, eyebrow slightly raised; affection disguised as sarcasm.

expressions.name: Exagero cômico
expressions.direction: Mock-grand seriousness, chin up, eyes half-closed as if announcing a great achievement; still no smile.

expressions.name: Exasperação contida
expressions.direction: A slow blink at the ceiling, lips pressed, patience visibly running out; no smile.

expressions.name: Falsa compaixão
expressions.direction: Exaggerated mock sympathy, brows lifted in the middle, lips pursed; clearly not sorry at all.

expressions.name: Surpresa fingida
expressions.direction: Eyebrows raised theatrically, mouth closed, deadpan; she is not surprised.

expressions.name: Duelo com June (desconfiança simpática)
expressions.direction: Narrowed eyes and a polite, dangerous calm, head tilted, studying an opponent she secretly likes.

expressions.name: A encarada
expressions.direction: A long unblinking stare, arms crossed, waiting for an answer she will get eventually.

expressions.name: Cúmplice (afetuosa)
expressions.direction: A warm look of complicity at Claire, eyes soft, mouth still dry; they understand each other without words.

expressions.name: Cuidando de Claire
expressions.direction: Handing over a coffee with a stern look that means "eat something"; care disguised as orders.

expressions.name: Orgulho de Claire
expressions.direction: Watching Claire work, a quiet pride in her eyes that she would never say out loud.

expressions.name: O sorriso que escapa
expressions.direction: A small reluctant smile that escapes for a second before she catches it; she hates being caught.

expressions.name: Desconfiança de Olivia
expressions.direction: Cool, measuring look, chin down, lips pressed; polite and unconvinced.

expressions.name: A piada morre na boca
expressions.direction: About to make a joke, mouth slightly open, and she stops: the joke dies; her face goes still.

expressions.name: Séria (o corpo para)
expressions.direction: Arms crossed, completely still, serious, no smile, not even in the eyes.

expressions.name: Protetora
expressions.direction: Standing slightly in front of Claire, shoulders square, jaw set, eyes on the threat.

expressions.name: A dor pela amiga (nível 1)
expressions.where: EP03 SC005 ("She gave her seven years.", KF SH09 V02)
expressions.direction: Brows lifted in the middle, green eyes glistening, mouth soft and closed; sad for her best friend, not angry; no tear.

expressions.name: Raiva fria por Claire
expressions.direction: Very still, eyes hard and cold, jaw tight; quiet fury on Claire's behalf; no shouting.

expressions.name: Surpresa real
expressions.direction: Real surprise: eyebrows up, eyes wide, lips parted for a second.

expressions.name: Entendendo só com o olhar
expressions.direction: The moment she understands who Olivia is: eyes widen slightly, then go still; she says nothing.
expressions.note: Na prancha a mudança é sutil; na cena (EP01 SC006), o slide com o nome de Olivia logo antes dá a leitura

expressions.name: Percebendo que June sabe
expressions.direction: Eyes narrowing on June, a small realization: June knows something.

expressions.name: Reflexiva (vulnerável)
expressions.direction: Alone for a moment, the armor of jokes off: tired eyes, a softer, sadder face.

expressions.name: Serena
expressions.direction: Relaxed and calm, eyes soft, a quiet ease in her face.

expressions.name: Empolgada
expressions.direction: Bright eyes and lifted brows, leaning in with energy; her version of excitement, still without a big smile.

sheets.name: Essenciais
sheets.edits: V01 → V02 no ChatGPT: EXP-M-13 com o carinho nos olhos; EXP-M-24 com os lábios entreabertos (mudanças sutis)
